== Description ==
Original Japanese [[Mobquet A-1 Deluxe Floater (Japanese)|Mobquet A-1 Deluxe Floater]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]], black-border printing. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
